labels.name: status: needs-triage
labels.description: Awaiting maintainer assessment; not a claim of confirmation

labels.name: status: needs-info
labels.description: Waiting for specific details needed to assess or reproduce

labels.name: status: confirmed
labels.description: Maintainer has verified the issue in the stated environment

labels.name: status: in-progress
labels.description: An assigned contributor is actively working on this

labels.name: status: blocked
labels.description: Work cannot proceed until a named dependency is resolved

labels.name: severity: critical
labels.description: Widespread outage or unrecoverable data loss; assess immediately

labels.name: severity: high
labels.description: Lost work, unintended actions, or a core workflow blocked

labels.name: severity: medium
labels.description: Incorrect behavior with a usable workaround or limited scope

labels.name: severity: low
labels.description: Visual, wording, or minor inconvenience

labels.name: priority: p0
labels.description: Immediate scheduling priority, explicitly set by maintainers

labels.name: priority: p1
labels.description: Next available work, explicitly set by maintainers

labels.name: priority: p2
labels.description: Planned normal-priority work

labels.name: priority: p3
labels.description: Backlog work without a near-term commitment
